details.detail: Door-3 self-service bar (m05, m06, m17, q11) vs samchui_11. The ash lower cabinets with round pulls, the black upper unit with its monitor and bottle columns, the bright nosing and the new steel guard rail along the back and ends of the counter all match. The monument depth is still 1.05 m against about 1.9 m on the map; that is a user decision.

Door-2 welcome galley (m03, m16) vs lalf_134 and sp_09. The open ash-framed bay, the dark interior, the monitor, the brewer, the ash lower doors and the dark soffit with downlights all read correctly. The black glass door at the passage end in m16 is large and featureless and has no photo support.
Door-2 aft monuments (m04, m13). The ash wall, the 7K galley with its ash doors and both door-2 jump seats are present. The passage orientation is still open as a user decision.

F front wall, flight-deck door and door 1 (q01, m01, m02). This is the biggest gain since round 3. The aisles are now clear: q01 shows two slim tied bundles at the opening edges, and in m02 the flight-deck corridor, the door and the lav are visible between them. The closet faces are still flat dark slabs (#413838) with none of the streaked ebony grain in tpa_IMG_0260. In tpg_147 the F-front curtains hang as loose full-height panels, while the model ties them.

Lavatory exteriors (m03, m05, m09, m11, m17). The J ash doors with a white seam and grab handle follow OMAAT Room-32, and the PY/Y lavs have white bi-fold doors with signs. The F dark-wood lav shares the flat-ebony problem.
F/J bulkhead, J face, and the J backs of the door monuments (m07, m14, m15). The cream wall, the wall boxes with blue tops and the tied charcoal curtains all match tpg_71 and tt_cabin1.

J/PY bulkhead, PY face (m08, q13). The flat charcoal-framed monitors (two per outboard panel, four in the centre) match alv_IMG_7207/7209. The J/PY curtain is now a tied bundle in warm charcoal (render #544f4c, b-r -7; alv #38312b), which fixes the round-3 navy panel.

Door-4 group (m09, m10, q13). The wheelchair lav, the centre galley, the right galley with the new 4R jump seat and the row-30 monitors are all in place. The PY aft curtains are in the aisles and let people through. There is still no 4L attendant seat (user decision).

Rear, door 5 (m11, m12, q19). The fore-aft galleys, the aft-wall stowage and three jump seats (two left, one right) match the map. q19 still frames only econ seatbacks in front of a white wall, so the rear galley is shown only in m12. The aft-wall stowage is approximated, with no photo.

Standard galley inserts (m01, m09, m12). The layout is plausible and the latches are small red paddles, but every insert is the same cool brushed grey and every oven window is the same flat beige quad. sp_09 and lalf_133 show warmer grey-beige inserts with small blue LED windows. This is unchanged from round 3.

Curtains overall. Every aisle is now clear. The tied bundles (F/J, J, J/PY, F front) have real folds and a tieback, and the colours are right: F/J and J/PY warm charcoal, PY aft slate at b-r 15 (photo 19). The untied panels (PY aft and rear) are still about 0.24 m wide, straight and full height, so in m10 and m11 they read as columns. In py_37302 and y_47300 they are wider gathered panels, about 0.35-0.4 m, with an irregular hem.

Jump seats and Type A door linings. There are now 10 seats: 1L, 1R, 2L, 2R, 3L, 3R, 4R, two at 5L and one at 5R. 4L is missing (user decision). The door lining is now correct in kind (m17, m18): an arc about 0.48 m across (measured against the 1.07 m door), a horizontal lever, a full-width bustle and a girt bar with a flag placard. The arc's arrowhead is only a small block and there is no 'OPEN' lettering.

issues.detail: Untied curtain panels (PY aft, rear) still read as columns
issues.problem: _curtainPanel is hx 0.095 x 0.95 x (1+0.35), about 0.24 m across and 0.09 m deep, with the same section from floor to track. In m10 (navy) and m11 (light grey) it is a straight fluted pillar.
issues.evidence: py_37302: the PY aft curtains are gathered panels about 0.35-0.4 m wide, flaring toward the floor, with an uneven hem. y_47300: the rear curtains are similar.
issues.fix: Widen the panel to about 0.34 m at the hem and 0.26 m at the track, make it asymmetric (flatter against the edge it gathers to), and vary the lobe amplitude with height so the folds are not uniform flutes. Keep the aisle clearance of 0.45 m or more.

issues.detail: Door-3 monument depth 1.05 m vs map (4th round; user decision)
issues.evidence: On ana_seatmap_73E the door-3 lav boxes are about 1.9 m deep, scaled by rows 17-20.
issues.fix: Waiting on the user: either follow the map or keep the rows.

issues.problem: L.jumps has 4R (2.32, dz[3][0]) but nothing at 4L.
issues.evidence: Every floor-level Type A exit has an adjacent attendant seat. The wheelchair-lav end beside 4L is bare in m09.
issues.fix: Waiting on the user: add a wall-mounted seat on the wheelchair lav's door-facing end, or confirm there is none.

issues.problem: The q01 closet walls and the m02 corridor wall are a uniform #413838 with no grain.
issues.evidence: tpa_IMG_0260 shows strong horizontal reddish-purple streaking.
issues.fix: Apply the wood/ash grain layer to darkWood at a horizontal scale of about 0.1 m, with a higher contrast.

issues.problem: Every oven and chiller face is the same cool brushed grey with an identical beige window.
issues.evidence: sp_09 and lalf_133 show warm grey-beige inserts with small blue LED windows.
issues.fix: Warm the insert material and vary the insert types; use small blue LED windows instead of beige quads.

issues.detail: q19 still misses the rear galley (integration)
issues.problem: The view walk(0, 1.62, 58.9, PI) renders row 41/42 seatbacks against the white centre wall.
issues.fix: Integration: move the camera to the door-5 cross-aisle, or use m12 for the rear pair.

issues.detail: Arming arc lacks the arrowhead and 'OPEN' lettering
issues.problem: The arc ends in plain small blocks.
issues.evidence: lalf_133 and the door-2 photos show a painted band with an arrowhead and the word OPEN.
issues.fix: Add a triangular arrowhead and a small 'OPEN' atlas label at the aft end.
